title: Mori’s photograph, a shared page and tea
caption: Tuesday art is now playable with the selected Lillehammer photograph. Watch Mori sketch, offer a spare page, and on a later visit pour tea or leave a pencil beside him. All native attempts remain below.

sections.title: Photograph, shared page and tea
sections.caption: Independent reviewer codex:crowd-recovery: bounded physical art staging: 8/10, no source or visual blocker. Photo, placed paper, open-cup pour and actual graphite contact were inspected at both sizes. Phone photo has modest scale/some portrait overlap; the phone drawing view is a Mori-hand detail with the other player incidental at the edge. No whole-room or art-style rescore.
